chapter: Brass bands, lessons and Tubby's story
title: No relation to Edmund Hall, and Tubby's first Chicago work
summary: Hall clears up that he is not related to Edmund Hall, and says Tubby played small jobs with a doctor's band before joining the Dixieland group.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well, I guess you weren't any relation to the Halls that played clarinet like Edmund Hall and his brother Clarence. No, no, no, no relation at all. No relation? There's another fellow, Rene Hall, from there. No, no, no, no. No relation to him. No, anything to do with it.

Thought he'd clear that up, you know, because sometimes they'd make a mistake. Sure, no, a lot of people thought Edmund Hall and I were brothers. Yeah. No relation at all. First time I met him out here. Yeah. So there was no relation at all there, just a different Hall altogether. But when he went up the first time he didn't exactly go to play music, because see when he first went there, he first played with a fellow, he called him Dr. something, he used to play all the little forward and things around there. I can't think of his name. Now he was working with those bands before he joined Dixeland Band again. Yeah, he was doing all right.
